Cowork Context Packager

Package content into a Cowork project context file.

What it does

Formats content into a production-ready context file for a Cowork project. It applies the on-demand loading model, writes cross-references, generates a routing trigger for instructions.md, and proposes that edit directly - so the file is wired in, not just written.

When to use it

You have content - from the Knowledge Base Context Builder, an existing file, or notes - that needs to become a Cowork context file, or you are converting a Claude.ai Projects context file to Cowork format.

How to trigger it

"package this for Cowork"

"format this as a Cowork context file"

"make a Cowork context file from this"
